experimental_design.evidence: inferred: We investigated drug effects using protein synthesis and degradation inhibitors on global and specific protein turnover in single cells and performed a large-scale time-series SC-pSILAC analysis of undirected differentiation of human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSC) encompassing six sampling times over two months and analyzed >1000 cells.
